epics.title: EPIC — Human accessibility and usability testing
epics.note:
## Summary
This epic builds on a real VoiceOver + Safari pass and owner spot checks completed 2026-07-28. It remains Backlog and the sole remaining NO-GO condition because the unresolved VoiceOver navigation-mode question, NVDA and TalkBack passes, Safari Full Keyboard Access confirmation, touch-target review, specialist judgement and disabled-user study are still outstanding.

## Context block — a fresh agent starts here
- **Goal:** Complete the outstanding assistive-technology, keyboard, visual-adaptation, specialist and disabled-user journey testing and disposition every finding.
- **Why it matters:** The completed VoiceOver and owner spot checks do not replace the outstanding NVDA, TalkBack, specialist and disabled-user evidence needed to lift the NO-GO.
- **Files to touch:** none — decision ticket
- **Read exactly this and nothing more:** AGENTS.md, TASKVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, this ticket
- **Do NOT read:** AUDIT_REPORT_2026-07-22.md whole, AUDIT_EVIDENCE_2026-07-22/, archive/
- **Constraints:** Human testing cannot be replaced by automated checks. Preserve the 2026-07-28 evidence: a real VoiceOver + Safari pass occurred with one unresolved navigation-mode question, and the owner completed 200% text, 400% zoom/reflow, 320px portrait, forced-colours and print/print-to-PDF spot checks with no defects found. NVDA and TalkBack have never been run; touch-target sizing, a specialist judgement and the disabled-user study remain outstanding. Findings must be written as reproducible issues rather than broad redesign requests.
- **Done when:**
  - A dated record repeats the VoiceOver + Safari test with item-by-item navigation and records whether the unresolved reading-order observation is a defect or expected rotor behaviour.
  - A dated NVDA test record covers the wizard, a results page and a guide page, with each finding written reproducibly.
  - A dated TalkBack test record covers the wizard, a results page and a guide page on Android, with each finding written reproducibly.
  - A dated Safari keyboard record covers Full Keyboard Access both enabled and disabled and records the product decision for Safari keyboard users.
  - The 2026-07-28 owner record remains attached for 200% text, 400% zoom/reflow, 320px portrait, forced-colours and print/print-to-PDF spot checks with no defects found.
  - A dated touch-target record measures every interactive target and records each undersized target as fixed, explicitly accepted, deferred with owner approval, or otherwise dispositioned.
  - A dated reduced-motion and scroll-reveal test record states the tested behaviours and records each finding reproducibly.
  - A dated specialist review records the specialist judgement and reproducible findings, including whether contrast clears 4.5:1 on every background including semantic soft tints.
  - A dated disabled-user study record covers keyboard, switch, voice, magnification and assistive technology, plus cognitive fatigue, pain and financial stress; participant count and protocol are TBD — owner to specify.
  - Every finding from these records is fixed, explicitly accepted, deferred with owner approval, or otherwise dispositioned before the epic closes.
- **Priority: High** — High because this is the sole remaining NO-GO condition.

epics.title: EPIC — Testing and quality infrastructure
epics.note:
## Summary
This epic adds a systematic eligibility oracle across every catalogue program and reaches a bounded disposition for CI flakiness. It remains Backlog because the oracle is missing and the CI family is rarer, not eliminated.

## Context block — a fresh agent starts here
- **Goal:** Give every catalogue program asserted ready, almost and no outcome sets, and reach a measured, regression-guarded disposition for CI flakiness under the job cap.
- **Why it matters:** Eligibility outcomes need systematic regression coverage, and CI flakiness has blocked good releases.

- **Read exactly this and nothing more:** AGENTS.md, TASKVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, this ticket
- **Do NOT read:** AUDIT_REPORT_2026-07-22.md whole, AUDIT_EVIDENCE_2026-07-22/, archive/
- **Constraints:** Keep retries: 0, do not default the suite to reduced motion, and do not weaken mutation-tested guards. Do not claim future CI flakiness is eliminated; use a bounded verification set approved by the owner, with its run count TBD — owner to specify.
- **Done when:**
